en.title: King Salman: Saudi Arabia Was Established on Firm Foundations to Preserve the Faith, Justice
en.summary: King Salman stated that Saudi Arabia was founded on strong foundations aimed at preserving faith and justice.

stories.title: Saudi FM calls for implementation of Gaza peace plan, renewed push for Palestinian statehood

en.title: Saudi FM calls for implementation of Gaza peace plan, renewed push for Palestinian statehood
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister urged the immediate implementation of a US-backed Gaza peace plan and called for international action against Israeli settlement expansion and annexation policies in the West Bank.

stories.title: السكتيوي: فخور بما قدمته عمان أمام العراق

en.title: Al-Sektiaoui: Proud of what Oman presented against Iraq
en.summary: Oman's coach expressed pride in his team's performance, noting that the match against Iraq was challenging due to differences in preparation and stability between the two squads.

en.title: Oman refuses to fall against Iraq
en.summary: Iraq and Oman drew 1-1 in their opening match of the 27th Gulf Cup, with Iraq scoring first before Oman equalized in the second half.

stories.title: US will honor defense commitments to Saudi Arabia, Rubio says

en.title: US will honor defense commitments to Saudi Arabia, Rubio says
en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the United States will uphold its defense agreement with Saudi Arabia amid regional tensions and attacks by Houthi forces on the Kingdom.

stories.title: Former Mexico boss Aguirre returns to Spain with Valencia

en.title: Former Mexico boss Aguirre returns to Spain with Valencia
en.summary: Javier Aguirre, who previously coached Mexico's national team and led Real Mallorca to the Copa del Rey final, has been appointed as Valencia's new head coach in La Liga.

stories.title: King Salman orders mosque north of Riyadh named after King Abdulaziz

en.title: King Salman orders mosque north of Riyadh named after King Abdulaziz
en.summary: King Salman has ordered a mosque to be constructed north of Riyadh and named after King Abdulaziz, with an 88,000 square meter plot allocated for the project as tribute to the kingdom's founder.

stories.title: Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Directs Naming Mosque North of Riyadh After King Abdulaziz

en.title: Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Directs Naming Mosque North of Riyadh After King Abdulaziz
en.summary: The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques has directed that a mosque to be built north of Riyadh be named after King Abdulaziz.

stories.title: King Salman: Saudi Arabia founded on firm principles to preserve faith, establish justice

en.title: King Salman: Saudi Arabia founded on firm principles to preserve faith, establish justice
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King Salman marked the kingdom's 96th National Day by emphasizing the foundational principles of faith preservation and justice established by the nation's founder King Abdulaziz and sustained through national leadership and citizen commitment.

stories.title: Saudi foreign minister co-chairs high-level meeting on Palestinian peace process in New York

en.title: Saudi foreign minister co-chairs high-level meeting on Palestinian peace process in New York
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan co-chaired a meeting with France, the United Kingdom, and Canada in New York focused on Palestinian peace efforts and a comprehensive Gaza peace plan. He urged countries that have not yet done so to recognize the State of Palestine.

stories.title: Meeting of Trump with regional FMs reviews efforts to contain tensions and prevent spillover of the conflict

en.title: Meeting of Trump with regional FMs reviews efforts to contain tensions and prevent spillover of the conflict
en.summary: President Donald Trump convened a multilateral meeting in New York with foreign ministers from GCC nations, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria, and Türkiye to discuss regional tension containment and strengthen diplomatic efforts on ongoing crises.

stories.title: Aguirre Hired by Valencia after Latest Coaching Stint with Mexico at World Cup

en.title: Aguirre Hired by Valencia after Latest Coaching Stint with Mexico at World Cup
en.summary: Valencia appointed Aguirre as manager following his recent role coaching Mexico at the World Cup.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia advances to 13th rank in World Competitiveness Yearbook

en.title: Saudi Arabia advances to 13th rank in World Competitiveness Yearbook
en.summary: Saudi Arabia climbed to 13th position globally out of 70 countries in the 2026 IMD World Competitiveness Yearbook, ranking third among G20 nations and placing highly in business formation support and economic opportunity indicators.

stories.title: ‎US oil inventories rise 3M barrels last week

en.title: US oil inventories rise 3M barrels last week
en.summary: US crude oil inventories increased by 3 million barrels during the week ending September 18, reversing three consecutive weeks of declines and exceeding market expectations for a drop.

stories.title: ‎Aramco plans new gas unit, potential listing

en.title: Aramco plans new gas unit, potential listing
en.summary: Saudi Aramco is restructuring its operations to create a dedicated gas division, expanding from two main divisions to three, each with its own leadership. The company is exploring capital-raising options including potential stock market listings of certain business units.

stories.title: ‎King Salman: Saudi state foundations built on faith, justice

en.title: King Salman: Saudi state foundations built on faith, justice
en.summary: King Salman stated that National Day reflects on the Kingdom's foundational principles established under its founder King Abdulaziz, emphasizing faith and justice. He expressed prayers for Saudi Arabia's continued security, stability, and prosperity.

stories.title: ‎King Salman approves King Abdulaziz mosque north of Riyadh

en.title: King Salman approves King Abdulaziz mosque north of Riyadh
en.summary: King Salman approved naming a mosque north of Riyadh after King Abdulaziz, with an 88,000-square-meter plot allocated for construction. The mosque honors the late king's national legacy and his role in unifying the Kingdom and building mosques throughout Saudi Arabia.
